title: minuartia recurva subsp. bigerrensis
intro: Minuartia recurva subsp. bigerrensis, commonly known as Bigelow's catchfly, is a plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Bigelow's catchfly, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal effects. Research on this plant has shown potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities, which could contribute to its therapeutic applications.
